//: Install verdict cases that apps/web/lib/agent/verdict.test.ts and packages/cli/test/explain.test.ts both run, so the website's explain_install and `apm explain` cannot drift apart. Every name is x, every range latest; lost points are what the score lost. coverage is the verdict's structured coverage field; both copies must give it. A review of kind answer is the registry's raw GET /-/apm/v1/review answer (status and body): each copy reads it through its own parser, so a field one of them drops shows up here. Since the warn-not-block policy (2026-11) a score, an incomplete analysis, no score or a flagged dependency is review-first with a summary that says it installs; do-not-install is only for revoked, yanked and confirmed malicious.
